title: Fragment dispatch can leave its temporary target in the DOM
author: OskarEichler
body_preview: ## Description  Experimental Fragment `dispatchEvent` inserts a private temporary node at the Fragment position, but listener/node cleanup only runs after a normal native dispatch return. title: Browser server task queue drains in quadratic time
author: OskarEichler
body_preview: ## Description  The browser server stream scheduler stores pending callbacks in an array and removes one per `MessageChannel` delivery with `Array.shift()`. title: Fragment event listeners cannot be re-added after signal abort
author: OskarEichler
body_preview: ## Description  Experimental Fragment refs retain listener registry entries registered with an `AbortSignal` after the signal removes those listeners from every host child. A subsequent add with the same type/callback/capture is treated as a duplicate and does nothing. An already-aborted signal is also recorded even though host elements reject the registration, blocking a later valid add.  ## Repr...

title: React Compiler stack helpers overflow on deeply nested scopes
author: OskarEichler
